entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was the night before my trip to..."
entries.dialogueText: It was the night before my trip to Kyrute for the Alliance of Nations meeting.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had just finished some last-minut..."
entries.dialogueText: I had just finished some last-minute preparations in my study. I carefully made my way back towards the palace's residential wing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I reached the top floor. Across the..."
entries.dialogueText: I reached the top floor. Across the hall from my bedchamber, the Queen Mother's door was open a crack.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked in. My mother was standing..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked in. My mother was standing out on her balcony, her back turned towards me. I heard her whispering softly to herself.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I tapped her on the shoulder. She l..."
entries.dialogueText: I tapped her on the shoulder. She looked startled for a moment, then smiled.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can't sleep?""
entries.dialogueText: "Can't sleep?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good evening, Mother.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good evening, Mother."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Grand Wiseman Ignacius' quarters we..."
entries.dialogueText: Grand Wiseman Ignacius' quarters were on the ground floor. I saw light coming out of the keyhole.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I carefully bent down and looked in..."
entries.dialogueText: I carefully bent down and looked inside. Sal was rocking back and forth in his armchair, his eyes closed. He seemed to be mouthing a prayer.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I proceeded towards the end of the..."
entries.dialogueText: I proceeded towards the end of the hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Just before the stairs was the entr..."
entries.dialogueText: Just before the stairs was the entrance to Vina's room. Through the door, I caught the faint strains of her voice.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I pressed my ear against the door i..."
entries.dialogueText: I pressed my ear against the door in order to hear better.
entries.menuText: Press your ear against the door.

entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Yes, I agree. It seems like an ade..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I agree. It seems like an adequate compromise."

entries.dialogueText: "...No, he hasn't written back yet. Who knows if he's even read it?"

entries.dialogueText: "What, are you mad? Of course Father doesn't know anything about it."

entries.dialogueText: "...Yes, my love. We'll speak very soon."

entries.dialogueText: I passed Vina's door and walked up the stairs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a clunk as she hung up th..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a clunk as she hung up the phone. I moved away from the door and kept walking.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked startled for a moment, t..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked startled for a moment, then smiled.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Don't worry about me, darling. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry about me, darling. You should be resting yourself."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""All set for tomorrow?""
entries.dialogueText: "All set for tomorrow?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You shouldn't sneak up on an old w..."
entries.dialogueText: "You shouldn't sneak up on an old woman like that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked startled for a moment, t..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked startled for a moment, then smiled.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I'm surprised you're still up. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm surprised you're still up. You have a long day ahead of you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course I am. The Alliance of Na..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course I am. The Alliance of Nations won't know what hit it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sure. Can I ask you something abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sure. Can I ask you something about Vina?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Did Father tell you anything about..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did Father tell you anything about these AN sessions?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not really. Diplomacy isn't exactl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not really. Diplomacy isn't exactly my forte."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""That's my boy.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's my boy."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""We need our land back. No matter w..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need our land back. No matter what kind of announcement Wiktor Smolak has up his sleeve."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""There's nothing to it. Just stand..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's nothing to it. Just stand up straight, smile, preach unity and cooperation..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Oh, you know he was no diplomat.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, you know he was no diplomat."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""In fact, I'm not sure he even atte..."
entries.dialogueText: "In fact, I'm not sure he even attended after the Zille agreement. Poor Mr. Esquibel went alone in his stead."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enough is enough. He will pay for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough is enough. He will pay for his disrespect."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How do you know he's going to make..."
entries.dialogueText: "How do you know he's going to make an announcement?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""My whisper networks aren't what th..."
entries.dialogueText: "My whisper networks aren't what they used to be. But wives still talk."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I care for Mr. Esquibel dearly, bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I care for Mr. Esquibel dearly, but he has given Wehlen the benefit of the doubt for too long."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't want a confrontation. Our..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want a confrontation. Our countries are on the same side."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Oh, Romus. You still believe that?""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, Romus. You still believe that?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""And then stab the bastards in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "And then stab the bastards in the back when they least expect it."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""What about our princess?""
entries.dialogueText: "What about our princess?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What has she been doing while I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "What has she been doing while I'm at my council meetings?

entries.dialogueText: "Would it be crazy if I married her off to Rico?"

entries.dialogueText: "I'll tell you this much. The last thing you want to do is forbid her from seeing him."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Come, dear. Did you really think o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come, dear. Did you really think one dance in Sallabes would be enough for those two?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am the king. If I order her not..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am the king. If I order her not to see him, she'll have to obey."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She snorted."
entries.dialogueText: She snorted.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You've been talking to your uncle,..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've been talking to your uncle, I see."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You know how your father and I met..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know how your father and I met, don't you?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""That much is true.""
entries.dialogueText: "That much is true."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Next thing you know, she's throwin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Next thing you know, she's throwing all of her influence at the Council to persuade them that a fisherman's daughter is a suitable match for a prince."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Who said anything about forbidding..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who said anything about forbidding? I *want* them to get together."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know that. I'm not stupid.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know that. I'm not stupid."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""After everything the Sazons did to..."
entries.dialogueText: "After everything the Sazons did to you? To us?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would never do that. She's allow..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would never do that. She's allowed to love whomever she wants."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's all fine. I've got a plan.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's all fine. I've got a plan."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Any advice for how to act, then?""
entries.dialogueText: "Any advice for how to act, then?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I was referring to Zille, my dear...."
entries.dialogueText: "I was referring to Zille, my dear. Or have you forgotten that the handover deadline is imminent?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Actually, I'd rather not discuss this with you. You're not exactly impartial on Zille."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Impartiality won't get you anywher..."
entries.dialogueText: "Impartiality won't get you anywhere with Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lespia will help me out. We have a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia will help me out. We have an arrangement."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I say don't stoop to his level. Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "I say don't stoop to his level. Make him look like the tyrant he is."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You always do.""
entries.dialogueText: "You always do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He wasn't wrong about keeping powe..."
entries.dialogueText: "He wasn't wrong about keeping power within the Toras family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He was right. Young people can't b..."
entries.dialogueText: "He was right. Young people can't be trusted to follow their hearts."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There's a spark between those two,..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's a spark between those two, I can tell."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I'm just weighing the possibilities."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""*Especially* after what we've both..."
entries.dialogueText: "*Especially* after what we've both been through."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I checked the corner for Bruno, but..."
entries.dialogueText: I checked the corner for Bruno, but his dog bed was empty. I looked at my own bed and saw that he'd made himself comfortable there.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Shoo! Bad dog!""
entries.dialogueText: "Shoo! Bad dog!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Get a move on, boy. The King needs..."
entries.dialogueText: "Get a move on, boy. The King needs his rest."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All right. You can sleep here toni..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. You can sleep here tonight, but don't get too used to it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Bruno curled up at my feet as I got..."
entries.dialogueText: Bruno curled up at my feet as I got in bed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Bruno reluctantly hopped off the be..."
entries.dialogueText: Bruno reluctantly hopped off the bed and trotted back to his corner. He was nearly as agile on three legs as he'd been on four.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I tried to sleep, but was too distr..."
entries.dialogueText: I tried to sleep, but was too distracted by thoughts of the day ahead.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I climbed into bed, but was too dis..."
entries.dialogueText: I climbed into bed, but was too distracted by thoughts of the day ahead to sleep.

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Which elephant? There are so many.""
entries.dialogueText: "Which elephant? There are so many."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""A wonder that you world leaders ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "A wonder that you world leaders can squeeze in amongst all those pachyderms."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""But I was referring to Zille. Or h..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I was referring to Zille. Or have you forgotten that the handover deadline is imminent?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There is no elephant. I've neutral..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is no elephant. I've neutralized the Pales situation for now."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Have you so quickly forgotten? The..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you so quickly forgotten? The Zille handover deadline is almost upon us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duchess Azaro has a level head. Sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duchess Azaro has a level head. She won't drag us into conflict without reason."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Oh, there's always a reason.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, there's always a reason."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Estela Wehlen Talk

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She snorted."
entries.dialogueText: She snorted.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Don't forget what happened when Ly..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't forget what happened when Lyza the Great tried to forbid your father from seeing the Whore of Zille."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You were working as a waitress in..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were working as a waitress in a cocktail bar."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You used your feminine wiles to en..."
entries.dialogueText: "You used your feminine wiles to entrap him."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Hardly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hardly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was always confused about that...."
entries.dialogueText: "I was always confused about that. Why did Lyza allow Father to date a commoner?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""She didn't, at first. But the more..."
entries.dialogueText: "She didn't, at first. But the more she tried to discourage him, the faster she drove him straight into the arms of the Whore of Zille."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She laughed loudly."
entries.dialogueText: She laughed loudly.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""It was only supposed to be a fling..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was only supposed to be a fling, at first. But when Lyza the Great caught wind of it, she did everything in her considerable power to stop her son from seeing me."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""And that, of course, was what drov..."
entries.dialogueText: "And that, of course, was what drove him straight into the arms of the Whore of Zille."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Everything worked out in the end,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everything worked out in the end, though, didn't it?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""If you call seriously undermining..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you call seriously undermining the monarchy 'working out', then yes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In my room. Pabel had already packe..."
entries.dialogueText: In my room. Pabel had already packed my suitcase and turned the bed down.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Well, tell the others not to push..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, tell the others not to push for too much too quickly. He's in Kyrute the next few days anyway."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked startled for a moment, t..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Just rehearsing the choice words I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just rehearsing the choice words I'm going to have with the royal laundress. How hard can it be to get red wine out of an albino fox stole?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She lit a cigarette and blew smoke..."
